_comment: THE ONLY FILE IN packages/content/geo/ A HUMAN EDITS. Everything else is generated.
DECLARED INTENT, NOT A PATCH. Every entry names NODE IDS and is applied against a freshly
generated candidate graph on every build. It is never a diff against a previous output, so
retuning the generator cannot rot it — a stale entry fails loudly instead of silently doing
nothing. Node ids derive from geonameid, so they survive a re-selection.
WHY forcedCorridors EXIST, measured. The water test samples the straight line between two
nodes and refuses the edge when too much of it is at sea. That is correct for a strait and
WRONG wherever a coast is concave: Athens to Patra is 177 km of Greek mainland, but the
great-circle between them crosses the Gulf of Corinth. The real road goes around, and the
circuity factor already prices that in. Concave coasts are the Mediterranean's whole
character, so this list is expected to be long around it.
WHY ferries ARE AUTHORED AND NEVER GENERATED. Nothing in the geometry knows which straits
carry a service. Inventing one would be indistinguishable from a fact, and a player would
have no way to tell. Each row is a crossing that really operates.
JSON rather than YAML for now: `yaml` is not a declared dependency of packages/tools, and
reaching it transitively through packages/content is the kind of thing that breaks later.
M3.6 moves this to overlay.yaml behind a loader in packages/content, where `yaml` IS
declared and where locate.ts can give findings a file:line:col.

forcedCorridors.reason: Athens-Patra. 177 km of mainland; the straight line crosses the Gulf of Corinth.
Istanbul-Canakkale. Mainland Thrace; the straight line crosses the Sea of Marmara.
Copenhagen-Hedensted. Fixed links across the Danish belts carry road traffic.
Jutland-Kiel. Denmark's land border with Germany; the straight line clips the Baltic.
Calabria-Puglia. Mainland Italy throughout; the straight line crosses the Gulf of Taranto.
Bursa-Istanbul. Road runs around the head of the gulf; the straight line crosses the Marmara.

ferries.reason: Palermo-Calabria across the Strait of Messina. Sicily's road link to the mainland.
Sardinia-Barcelona. Sardinia has no land link at any price.
Mallorca-Barcelona. The Balearics are reachable only by sea. Replaces an earlier Menorca row the overlay flagged as naming a node the selector had dropped.
Tunis-Palermo. Joins the Maghreb to Sicily and so to Europe.
